system.description:
You draw on inner reserves of physical power to perform great feats of strength, such as lifting heavy objects, leaping great distances, or hauling yourself up a cliff while weighed down by a Heavy Load.

Prerequisite: Strength 15

Effect: Once per encounter as a Full-Round Action, you can Take 20 on a Strength check or Strength-based Skill Check (You must be Trained in that Skill), even if distracted or threatened.

Normal: You may not Take 20 when distracted or threatened, or in a single round.

Special: After using this Feat for the first time in a given encounter, make a DC 15 Endurance check (As a Free Action). If the check succeeds, you can use this Feat once more during the same encounter.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
